summary: Eve identifies root cause: connection pool leak on client timeout in db_pool.py from commit a1f9c8d
raw_content: Found the issue! Looked at git diff for v2.4.1 commit a1f9c8d. In db_pool.py, the new async query wrapper does not release the connection back to the pool if client timeout occurs during HTTP requests. Connections stay orphaned until timeout. We are leaking DB connections rapidly.
embedding_text: [SLACK] [2026-10-30T14:16:45Z] #incidents-prod (eve.sec): Found the issue! Looked at git diff for v2.4.1 commit a1f9c8d. In db_pool.py, the new async query wrapper does not release the connection back to the pool if client timeout occurs during HTTP requests. Connections stay orphaned until timeout. We are leaking DB connections rapidly.
